RESOLVED: Dear Dana, 

Regarding your denied claim (CLM-550193) for the brain MRI on August 27, I apologize for the inconvenience. The denial reason was "prior authorization not on file". You have the right to appeal this decision within 180 days of the denial notice date. The exact deadline date for your appeal is [calculated based on the denial notice date]. 

To initiate the appeal process, please find attached the appeal form (FORM-APP-1). Your ordering provider, Dr. L. Okonjo, may submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting medical necessity. Standard appeals are decided within 30 calendar days. 

If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to me. I'm here to assist you.
